info.title: modulus
info.description:
Command-line interface for the Modulus framework.
      Scaffold modular-monolith applications, add modules, and generate CRUD code.

commands.name: add-ai
commands.description:
Host the AI platform's connector (wire contract v1) in the API host: read-only
capabilities, record lookups, extraction and the change feed, behind the
platform's API key and signed user envelope
